# Fixed strings law/engineering-code.md, the code rules that load on a code read, must carry, one
# per line; read by tests/short-law.test.sh. A line starting with # is a comment.
# caps
40 lines per function
3 parameters
3 levels of nesting
500 lines per file
# bans
`biome-ignore`
`eslint-disable`
`@ts-ignore`
`@ts-expect-error`
`@ts-nocheck`
`istanbul ignore`
`c8 ignore`
`v8 ignore`
non-null `!`
`catch (e) {}`
`.catch(() => {})`
`except: pass`
discarded into `_`
inline `interface` or `type` of 2+ properties
`*.types`
`TypeError`
`RangeError`
`RuntimeException`
`Promise.reject(new Error(...))`
`.only`
`fit`
`fdescribe`
`.skip`
`xit`
`xdescribe`
`test.todo`
`debugger`
`console.*`
# one thing per file
`*.constants`
`*.config`
`*.schema`
`*.styles`
read 2.2 before creating any file or folder
# principles
second caller
paste the search that found none
Leave nothing behind
Dead code that was there before your change is a follow-up
# clean-code floor
does or answers, never both
No flag parameters
Never mutate inputs
Fail fast at the boundary
One level of abstraction per function
Talk to what you hold
keeps its cause and context
awaited, returned or handled
Composition before inheritance
A closed set is a type
# refuse on sight
Add error handling later
a `TODO` with no owner
commented-out code
zero references
# performance guardrails
Never query or call per loop item
Parallelize independent I/O
Bound every result set
Bound every cache
Bound every fan-out
No sync blocking I/O
Filter on indexes
No O(n²) on unbounded input
Batch bulk writes
Stream large payloads
Stable props and keys in UI hot paths
before optimizing
# four principles
Think before coding
Simplicity first
Surgical changes
Goal-driven execution
→ verify:
never hunks of this diff
